_comment: Expected DRS VM-VM rules per site / cluster for the DRS rule compliance report. Every rule found in the cluster is checked anyway; rules listed here are also checked for existence, type and exact members. largeVmGB / mediumVmGB highlight big VMs in the host allocation table; vmNamePattern selects the VMs listed in the VM detail table (e.g. SQL). decommission lists VMs that should be gone.

rules.name: AA-SQL-PROD
rules.note: Example: production SQL pair, one VM per host
